## codegraph
# Codegraph — code intelligence over an indexed knowledge graph

Codegraph is a SQLite knowledge graph of every symbol, edge, and file in
the workspace — pre-computed structure you would otherwise re-derive by
reading files (cached intelligence: thousands of parse/trace decisions you
don't pay to re-reason each run). Reads are sub-millisecond; the index lags
writes by ~1s through the file watcher. Reach for it BEFORE *and* while
writing or editing code — not just for questions: one call returns the
verbatim source PLUS who calls it and what it affects, so you edit with the
blast radius in view. More accurate context, in far fewer tokens and
round-trips than reading files yourself.

## One tool: codegraph_explore — use it instead of reading files

There is a single tool, `codegraph_explore`, and it is Read-equivalent. It
takes either a natural-language question or a bag of symbol/file names and
returns the **verbatim, line-numbered source** of the relevant symbols
grouped by file — the same `<n>\t<line>` shape `Read` gives you, safe to
`Edit` from — PLUS the call path among them (including dynamic-dispatch hops
like callbacks, React re-render, and JSX children that grep can't follow) and
a blast-radius summary of what depends on them.

Whether you're answering "how does X work" or implementing a change (fixing a
bug, adding a feature), call `codegraph_explore` before you Read. ONE call
usually answers the whole question. Codegraph IS the pre-built search index —
so running your own grep + read loop, or delegating the lookup to a separate
file-reading sub-task/agent, repeats work codegraph already did and costs more
for the same answer. A direct codegraph answer is typically one to a few
calls; a grep/read exploration is dozens.

## How to query

- **Almost any question — "how does X work", architecture, a bug, "what/where is X", or surveying an area** → `codegraph_explore` with a natural-language question or the relevant names. ONE capped call returns the verbatim source grouped by file; most often the ONLY call y… [truncated]

- driver-code-reviewer: NuttX/Vela 驱动代码质量审查（59 Pattern + 双轮交叉验证 + 量化评分）。 Use when: driver review, driver code review, 驱动审查, 驱动代码审查, review driver, 审查驱动代码, NuttX driver review, 驱动质量检查, review nuttx/drivers, review arch/ driver, 驱动提交前检查. 即使用户只说"帮我审查下这个驱动"也应触发。 驱动开发/实现(use nuttx-driver-development).
- executor: Manage persistent interactive CLI processes (REPLs, debuggers, database CLIs, NuttX simulator, QEMU). Use when process maintains state across commands. NOT for one-off commands - use Bash. Prefer over tmux for programmatic I/O without terminal emulation.
- kconfig-tweak: Modify Linux kernel or NuttX .config files from command line without interactive menuconfig. Use when needing to enable/disable config options, set values, query option states, or batch-modify kernel configurations in scripts or CI/CD pipelines.
- memdump: Analyzes heap memory usage from NuttX/Vela runtime memdump logs, detects memory leaks, and identifies high-consumption modules. Use when debugging memory issues, tracking heap allocations, comparing memory usage between versions, or optimizing embedded system memory footprint.
- nuttx-driver-development: Create, update, review, or audit NuttX RTOS C device drivers. Covers sensor (uORB), char device, network (ethernet, MAC, PHY, DMA, netdev, SPI-Ethernet, CAN, SocketCAN, CAN FD, CAN bus, LIN, LIN bus, LIN master, LIN slave), framebuffer (fb, LCDC, display controller), LCD (SPI LCD, I2C LCD, ST7789, SSD1306, ILI9341, lcd_dev, lcd_framebuffer), USB (Host Controller Driver and device Controller Driver), audio (I2S smart PA, power amplifier, audio_comp), power/battery (charger, monitor, gauge), MCAL (AUTOSAR MCAL adaptation, EB Tresos, MCAL upper-half bridging), I2C/SPI bus, Kconfig/build integration, and board registration. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- analyze-project-kb: Analyze the entire RV1126B SportCam project and generate a comprehensive knowledge base
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

11	- **工作区根目录**: `/home/lijian/project/open-vela`
12	- **团队 overlay**: `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian`

15	- **主模型只做规划和审查**；宽泛搜索、机械修改、编译、打包、验证全部交给 Sonnet 或 Haiku 子代理。
16	- 项目有 **CodeGraph**（`.codegraph/` 目录已初始化），理解/定位代码前优先使用 CodeGraph，projectPath 为 `/home/lijian/project/open-vela`。
17	- **不使用 Workflow**；本项目分析用普通 Agent（Sonnet/Haiku）。
18	
19	## 已完成工作
20	
21	1. 原始 defconfig 只有 `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`、`CONFIG_NSH_READLINE=y` 等，缺少 serial console 配置。
22	2. 已在团队 overlay 文件 `board/contest_board/configs/nsh/defconfig` 中添加：
23	   ```
24	   CONFIG_DEV_CONSOLE=y
25	   CONFIG_SERIAL=y
26	   CONFIG_UART_SERIALDRIVER=y
27	   ```
28	3. 已执行 distclean 并成功编译：
29	   ```bash
30	   ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_135_board/configs/nsh -j8
31	   ```
32	4. 输出 ELF：`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/nuttx`；objcopy 后 `nuttx.bin` 约 80680 bytes。
33	5. 已打包：
34	   - `amp.img`：SDK `output/firmware/amp.img`，约 84K
35	   - `update.img`：SDK `output/update/Image/update.img`，约 1.4G
36	6. **打包流程**必须包含以下步骤：
37	   1. `riscv-none-elf-objcopy -O binary nuttx nuttx.bin`
38	      （工具路径：`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/riscv-none-elf/bin/riscv-none-elf-objcopy`）
39	   2. 复制 `nuttx.bin` 到 `$SDK/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/Image/rtt.bin`
40	   3. `$SDK/hal/tools/mkimage -f Image/amp.its -E -p 0xe00 Image/nuttx_amp.img`
41	   4. 复制为 `$SDK/output/firmware/amp.img`
42	   5. `$SDK/build.sh updateimg`
43	
44	## 当前实板现象
45	
46	烧录新 `update.img` 后串口输出：
47	
48	```
49	ABCDABCDPEFGTtSs0e0bLbcle0b
50	NuttShell (NSH)
51	!!!
52	```
53	
54	关键分析：
55	- **NSH banner 已输出**，TX 正常，`riscv_serialinit()` 很可能已执行且 `/dev/console` 注册成功。
56	- **键盘输入/回车完全无响应**，问题已缩小到 UART5 RX 链路：attach/rxint、IRQ 路由/INTMUX、IRQ 编号/dispatch、UART IIR/IER 宏，或 RX polling 缺失。
57	- **不要再把根因简单归为 `/dev/console` 未注册**；前一阶段已解决该问题。
58	
59	## 已知团队代码文件
60	
61	以下是下一步重点审查的文件（均在 `board/contest_board/` 下）：
62	
63	- `chip/rv1126b_serial.c`
64	  - UART5 base，IRQ 暂定 `61`
65	  - `riscv_earlyserialinit()` setup
66	  - `riscv_serialinit()` 注册 `/dev/console`、`/dev/ttyS0`
67	  - ops 包含 setup/attach/rxint/receive/rxavailable/interrupt
68	- `src/rv1126b_boot.c`
69	  - `board_late_initialize()` 调用 `rv1126b_bringup()`
70	- `src/rv1126b_bringup.c`
71	  - 当前主要挂 procfs 和调试字符
72	- `chip/rv1126b_irq.c`
73	- `chip/rv1126b_irq_dispatch.c`
74	- `chip/hardware/rv1126b_intmux.h`
75	- `chip/include/irq.h`
76	
77	## clear 前已启动的调查
78	
79	已并行派出三个只读 Agent。如果 clear 后结果不可用，**重新派发**，不要主模型亲自扫文件：
80	
81	1. **Sonnet（调查 A）**：映射所有调试字符（`ABCDABCDPEFGTtSs0e0bLbcle0b` 和 `!!!`），审查团队 UART RX 驱动和 IRQ/dispatch 实现。
82	2. **Haiku（调查 B）**：核对官方 NuttX serial upper-half / NSH open-read 调用链，只读官方代码，**禁止提出官方树修改**。
83	3. **Sonnet（调查 C）**：核对外部 Rockchip SDK 的 UART5_IRQn、INTMUX route、HPMCU IRQ 编号和 RT-Thread 基线。
84	
85	## 已返回的 Haiku 调查结论
86	
87	1. NSH banner 输出后进入 `readline_fd` → `read(fd0)` → `uart_read`；接收缓冲区为空时阻塞在 `recvsem`。
88	2. `uart_register` 只注册 inode；第一次 `uart_open` 才执行 `attach` 和 `rxint(true)`。console 因 `isconsole` 跳过 `setup`。
89	3. banner 正常而输入无反应最符合以下情况：`attach` 表面成功，但硬件 IRQ / INTMUX 未触发，导致 `uart_read` 永远阻塞。
90	4. 团队 `chip/rv1126b_idle.c` 已有 `up_idle` polling：UART5 RFNE 时调用 `uart_recvchars`。下一步必须确认该文件是否编入最终 ELF，以及最终 `up_idle` 符号是否来自团队实现。
91	5. `/dev/console` 与 `/dev/ttyS0` 共享同一个 `uart_dev` 双注册通常可用，不是首要根因。
92	6. 恢复后优先使用 `nm` / `objdump` 验证 `up_idle` 符号，再结合另外两个 Sonnet 调查核对 INTMUX。
93	
94	### Sonnet SDK 路由调查已完成
95	
96	- SDK `UART5_IRQn = 61`，团队 `CONSOLE_UART_IRQ = 61` 正确。
97	- UART5 对应 INTMUX group 1 bit 29；enable 寄存器地址为 `0x20b40004`，status 寄存器地址为 `0x20b40084`。
98	- 团队 INTMUX base/layout、`up_enable_irq`、status scan、IPIC SOI/EOI、`riscv_doirq(61)` 调度均与 SDK 一致，未发现 IRQ 编号或路由偏移错误。
99	- SDK UART5 console 同样是 interrupt-driven，不是 polling。
100	- 因此恢复后不要优先修改 IRQ 61 / INTMUX 常量；应优先检查 UART IER / IIR / USR 寄存器宏、IRQ 是否实际进入 handler、`up_idle` polling 是否链接生效，并使用调试字符和寄存器值定位。
101	
102	### Sonnet 团队 UART RX 驱动与调试字符调查已完成
103	
104	- 调试字符已映射：`A/B/C/D` 为启动阶段；`P` 为 clockconfig；`E/F/G` 表示运行到 `nx_start`；`T/t` 为 timer init；`S/s/0` 为 console / tty 注册；`e0b` 是 M-mode ecall；`L/b/c/l` 为 late init；`!!!` 是前三个 timer tick。系统已完整进入 NSH read 等待。
105	- Sonnet 审查认为 UART `attach` / `rxint` 流程表面正确。IIR handler 当前只处理一个 pending reason，未来可改为循环处理，但这通常只会导致偶发丢字符，不足以解释完全无输入。
106	- 该调查提出 NuttX 外部 IRQ 应增加 `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT` offset，但它同时确认团队当前 `attach(61)` 与 `dispatch(61)` 在内部是一致的。
107	
108	### 冲突审查要求
109	
110	- 另一份 SDK 专项调查已经通过 `soc.h`、RT-Thread INTMUX 和团队 irq dispatch 证明 raw IRQ `61`、group 1 bit 29、`0x20b40004` / `0x20b40084` 全链一致。
111	- **不要未经实板证据就把 IRQ 改成 `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT + 61`**；这可能反而破坏当前硬件 enable。恢复后不得直接照第三份调查的 IRQ offset 建议修改。
112	- 恢复后主模型应先让子代理做以下非侵入验证：
113	  1. 用 `nm` / `objdump` 确认 `up_idle` 的链接来源。
114	  2. 在团队 overlay 增加最小调试标记，确认 `uart_attach`、`rxint(true)` 和 ISR entry 是否执行。
115	  3. 读取并输出 IER、IIR、USR、INTMUX enable / status 寄存器值。
116	  4. 确认按键时 `UART_USR.RFNE` 是否置位。
117	  5. 根据上述实板证据再决定最小修复，不得先改 IRQ offset 常量。
118	- 三份调查现在均已完成。任务 #1 的调查阶段完成，但根因尚未经过实板证实。
119	
120	## 任务列表
121	
122	用 `TaskList` 查看是否保留了以下任务（若丢失则重建）：
123	
124	1. 定位 RV1126B UART RX 失效根因（调查阶段已完成；根因尚未实板证实）
125	2. 设计团队 overlay 最小修复（等待非侵入实板证据）
126	3. 实现并编译打包修复
127	4. 验证实板串口交互
128	
129	## 恢复后必须执行的顺序
130	
131	1. **先读取本恢复文档**，以及 memory 中以下条目：
132	   - `delegate-routine-work-to-subagents.md`
133	   - `use-codegraph-first.md`
134	   - `do-not-modify-nuttx-official-tree.md`
135	   - `rv1126b-openvela-contest-context.md`
136	2. 用 **TaskList** 查看任务状态。三份调查结果均已记录在本恢复文档中，不要重复做宽泛扫描；由子代理执行针对性的非侵入验证。
137	3. 主模型**审查三份调查结果及其冲突**，明确“已证实”“推测”和“待实板验证”。不得未经证据采用 `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT + 61` 建议。
138	4. 优先执行以下验证：
139	   - 用 `nm` / `objdump` 确认最终 ELF 中 `up_idle` 的符号来源，判断团队 polling 实现是否链接生效。
140	   - 用团队 overlay 内的最小调试标记确认 `uart_attach`、`rxint(true)` 和 UART ISR entry。
141	   - 读取并输出 UART IER / IIR / USR 与 INTMUX enable / status 寄存器值。
142	   - 确认按键时 `UART_USR.RFNE` 是否置位，以区分 UART 硬件接收、polling 和 IRQ handler 链路。
143	   - 保留已证实结论：raw IRQ 61、INTMUX group 1 bit 29 及当前 route/layout 与 SDK 一致；除非新实板证据推翻，不修改 IRQ 61 / INTMUX 常量。
144	5. 形成**只修改团队 overlay 的最小方案**。若需修改，实现交给 Sonnet；主模型只审查 diff。
145	6. 修改后由子代理执行 distclean、编译、objcopy、amp.img、update.img 全流程；主模型审查结果。
146	7. 让用户烧录测试，并要求提供完整串口日志。**验收标准**：出现 `nsh>` 提示符，回车能刷新提示符，`help` 和 `uname -a` 可执行。
147	
148	## 推荐的修复策略优先级
149	
150	- **首选**：先做 `up_idle` 链接来源、attach/rxint/ISR entry 和 UART/INTMUX 寄存器的非侵入验证，再根据实板证据修复团队 overlay。
151	- **不要优先修改** IRQ 61 / INTMUX 常量，也不得未经证据改成 `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT + 61`；SDK 专项调查已证明当前 raw IRQ 61 路由链一致。
152	- **备选**：若确认硬件外部 IRQ 尚未实际触发，且团队 `up_idle` polling 未生效，则在团队 overlay 中实现或修正一个最小、安全的 polling RX 临时方案以先打通 NSH；**不得修改官方 NuttX**。
153	- 保留必要的单字符调试标记和寄存器值输出，验证后再清理；不要一次做无关重构。
154	
155	---
156	
157	现在从 TaskList 和三个调查 Agent 的结果开始恢复；主模型仅规划和审查，所有搜索、修改、编译、打包、验证都交给 Sonnet/Haiku。不要修改 nuttx 官方代码。

## 先给结论

1. **现存 `rtthread.elf` 的实际中断路径**是：  
   `_start` → `entry()` → `rtthread_startup()` → `rt_hw_board_init()` → `rt_hw_interrupt_init()`（设 `mtvec=trap_entry`、开启 `mie.MEIP/MSIP`、使能 IPIC 0..15）→ UART 注册/安装 ISR → 首次 `mret` 通过 `MPIE` 转入全局 MIE 开启状态。  
   外部 IRQ 到来后：`trap_entry` → `handle_trap(IRQ_M_EXT)` → `m_ext_irq_handle()` → `INTMUX` 取活动源号 → `irq_desc[vector]` → UART ISR → IPIC `EOI`。

2. **UART5_IRQn 从 HAL 到 RT-Thread ISR 的编号始终为 61，没有加减任何基址或 offset。**  
   对 UART5，INTMUX 计算为 `group/index=1`、`bit=29`：使能寄存器 `0x20b40004` 的 bit29；状态寄存器 `0x20b40084` 的 bit29；再还原为 `1 * 32 + 29 = 61`。

3. **配置文件与现存 ELF/Map 不一致，不能视为同一次干净构建的产物。**
   - 当前 `.config` 选择 **EVB1 + uart4**；
   - 当前 `rtconfig.h`、`rtthread.map` 和 `rtthread.elf` 显示的是 **SportCam + uart5**。
   
   因而以下“实际链接”均指现存 `rtthread.elf` 对应的 Map；若以当前 `.config` 重新干净构建，则 UART5 的注册/ISR 不应被编入，目标应为 UART4。

---

## 1. 构建选择及产物一致性

### 构建端口实际选择：RISC-V SCR1

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtconfig.py:2-5`

  ```python
  ARCH     = 'risc-v'
  CPU      = 'scr1'
  CROSS_TOOL  = 'gcc'
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/SConscript:27-30`

  ```python
  elif rtconfig.CPU in list:
      group = group + SConscript(os.path.join(rtconfig.CPU, 'SConscript'))
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/SConscript:4-11`

  ```python
  src = Glob('*.c')
  if rtconfig.PLATFORM == 'gcc':
      src += Glob('*_gcc.S')
  ```

所以实际 CPU port 是：

- `rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/entry_gcc.S`
- `rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/context_gcc.S`
- `rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c`
- `rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/stack.c`

Map 也明确证明这些代码进入最终映像：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:5897-5928`

  ```text
  0x48c0b440 trap_entry
  0x48c0b568 rt_hw_interrupt_disable
  0x48c0b56e rt_hw_interrupt_enable
  0x48c0b574 rt_hw_context_switch
  0x48c0b61e rt_hw_context_switch_to
  0x48c0b66e rt_hw_context_switch_interrupt
  0x48c0b886 handle_trap
  0x48c0ba72 rt_hw_interrupt_init
  0x48c0baca rt_hw_interrupt_install
  ```

### Map 对应 ELF

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:8393`

  ```text
  OUTPUT(rtthread.elf elf32-littleriscv)
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtconfig.py:45-46` 启用了：

  ```python
  LFLAGS = ... '-Wl,--gc-sections,-cref,-Map=' + MAP_FILE
  ```

`rt_hw_interrupt_disable()` 的实际 SCR1 实现清除 `mstatus.MIE`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/board/common/board_base.c:139-177`

### 3.3 `mtvec`、IPIC、machine-local interrupt source 建立

实际 `mtvec` 指向的是 **SCR1 RT-Thread port 的 `trap_entry`**：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:349-365`

  ```c
  void rt_hw_interrupt_init(void)
  {
      write_csr(mtvec, &trap_entry);
      m_ext_irq_init();
      m_soft_irq_init();

      for (i = 0; i < MAX_HANDLERS; i++)
          rt_hw_interrupt_deactive(i);

      for (i = 0; i < 16; i++)
      {
          write_csr_ipic(IPIC_IDX, i);
          write_csr_ipic(IPIC_ICSR, IPIC_ICSR_IE);
      }
  }
  ```

其中：

- `m_ext_irq_init()` 设置 `mie.MEIP`；
- `m_soft_irq_init()` 设置 `mie.MSIP`；
- IPIC `IDX/ICSR` 的 0..15 路被使能；
- 所有 INTMUX 源先被 `rt_hw_interrupt_deactive()` 关闭。

相关 CSR 值：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/cpu/riscv_csr_encoding.h:991-1003`

  ```c
  #define IPIC_EOI   0xbf4
  #define IPIC_SOI   0xbf5
  #define IPIC_IDX   0xbf6
  #define IPIC_ICSR  0xbf7
  #define IPIC_ICSR_IE (1 << 1)
  ```

### 3.4 全局 MIE 的实际开启时点

`rt_hw_interrupt_init()` 只开启 `mie` 中的源位，不直接把 `mstatus.MIE` 置 1。首次全局开启来自首次线程切换后的 `mret`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/src/scheduler.c:248-269`

  ```c
  void rt_system_scheduler_start(void)
  {
      ...
      rt_hw_context_switch_to((rt_ubase_t)&to_thread->sp);
  }
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/stack.c:96-101`

  ```c
  stack_frame->epc     = (rt_ubase_t)tentry;
  // force to machine mode(MPP=11) and set MPIE to 1
  stack_frame->mstatus = 0x00001880;
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/context_gcc.S:153-194`

  ```asm
  rt_hw_context_switch_to:
      lw sp, (a0)
      ...
      lw a0, 2 * 4(sp)
      csrw mstatus, a0
      ...
      mret
  ```

即初始线程帧设置 `MPIE=1`，`mret` 返回时按 RISC-V 语义把它转移为 `MIE=1`。  
`rt_hw_interrupt_enable()` 本身只是恢复保存的完整 `mstatus`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/context_gcc.S:38-41`

  ```asm
  rt_hw_interrupt_enable:
      csrw mstatus, a0
      ret
  ```

## 4. 实际 Trap / IPIC / INTMUX / RT ISR 分发链

### 4.1 Trap 入口

Map 中实际保留的 trap 入口为：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:5897-5898`

  ```text

  ```

入口保存上下文、进入 RT-Thread IRQ 嵌套计数、读取 `mcause/mepc` 并调用 C 分发：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/entry_gcc.S:67-77`

  ```asm
  la   sp, _sp
  call rt_interrupt_enter
  csrr a0, mcause
  csrr a1, mepc
  mv a2, s0
  call handle_trap
  call rt_interrupt_leave
  ```

### 4.2 `mcause=IRQ_M_EXT` 进入 IPIC + INTMUX 路径

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:241-277`

  ```c
  case IRQ_M_EXT:
      m_ext_irq_handle();
      break;
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:112-134`

  ```c
  write_csr_ipic(IPIC_SOI, 0x0);
  irq = rt_hw_interrupt_get_active();
  if (irq == -1)
      return;

  isr_func = irq_desc[irq].handler;
  param = irq_desc[irq].param;
  isr_func(irq, param);

  write_csr_ipic(IPIC_EOI, 0x0);
  ```

实际语义是：

1. IPIC 写 `SOI`；
2. 不读取 IPIC `CISV` 来取 UART 号，而是由 BSP INTMUX 直接扫描活动源；
3. 将得到的原始 source number 直接索引 `irq_desc[irq]`；
4. 调用 RT ISR；
5. 写 IPIC `EOI`。

注意源代码字面行为：若 INTMUX 返回 `-1`，函数在上段 `return`，该分支不会执行后面的 `EOI`。

### 4.3 实际 INTMUX 实现

这是现存 ELF 实际使用的 INTMUX，不是 HAL 通用 INTMUX：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/drivers/int_mux.h:20-26`

  ```c

  #define INT_MUX_GROUP 0x80
  #define INT_GROUP     8
  ```

  ```c
  index = vector / 32;
  set = vector % 32;
  temp = *(unsigned int *)(INT_MUX + index * 4);
  *(unsigned int *)(INT_MUX + index * 4) = (1 << set) | temp;
  ```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/drivers/int_mux.c:38-62`

### UART5 的 INTMUX 精确位计算

对 `UART5_IRQn = 61`：

```text
index = 61 / 32 = 1
bit   = 61 % 32 = 29
```

因此：

```text
unmask: INT_MUX + index * 4
      = 0x20b40000 + 0x4
      = 0x20b40004，置 bit29

dispatch status:
      INT_MUX + INT_MUX_GROUP + index * 4
      = 0x20b40000 + 0x80 + 0x4
      = 0x20b40084，取 bit29

restore:
      cause = 1 * 32 + 29 = 61
```

**核实结果：61 从 SoC 枚举、HAL `.irqNum`、RT `irq_desc[61]`、INTMUX enable/status 编解码到 ISR 参数均保持原值；没有 `NUM_INTERRUPTS` 基址、IPIC 基址、IRQ offset 或 `+/-32` 转换。**

1. **现存 `rtthread.elf` 的实际中断路径**是：

## 1. `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT` 的实际数值是 27

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/include/irq.h:107-120`

3. RV1126B 这条实际链路是 **INTMUX + SCR1 IPIC**。机器外部中断进入 CPU 时，`mcause` 是 `0x8000000b`；IPIC 只做 SOI/EOI，实际 source 61 由 INTMUX status 扫描取得。没有标准 PLIC claim/complete 流程。
4. 在标准 NuttX RISC-V IRQ 命名空间中：
   - `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT = 27`
   - INTMUX/PLIC source 61 对应的逻辑 IRQ 是 `27 + 61 = 88`
5. 但是当前 overlay 的运行链路并未一半用 61、一半用 88，而是：
   - `irq_attach(61)`
   - `up_enable_irq(61)`，直接操作 INTMUX source 61
   - trap 中 `riscv_doirq(61)`
   - `g_irqvector[61]`
   
   因而它是一个**非标准、但当前 UART5 路径内部一致的 raw-source 模型**。
6. **不能根据当前代码确定“61 与 88 混用”造成 RX 无响应。静态证据反而表明当前 UART5 运行链没有发生这种混用。**
7. 如果只把 `CONSOLE_UART_IRQ` 改为 `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT + 61`，而不同时修改 controller 的减偏移和 dispatch 的加偏移，则会确定性出错：当前 `up_enable_irq(88)` 会开启 **group 2 bit 24 / `0x20b40008`**，而不是 UART5 的 group 1 bit 29。

```c
rt_uint32_t rt_hw_interrupt_get_active(void)
{
    rt_uint32_t cause = -1;
    int i, n;
    unsigned int int_reg;

    for (i = 0; i < INT_GROUP; i++)
    {
        if (*(unsigned int *)(INT_MUX + INT_MUX_GROUP + i * 4))
            break;
    }

    if (i < INT_GROUP)

    }

    return cause;
}
```

## 1. `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT` 的实际数值是 27

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/include/irq.h:107-120`

```c
#ifndef RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION
#  define RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION   (15)
#endif

/* IRQ (RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION + 1)- : (async event:interrupt=1) */

#define RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC         (RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION + 1)
#define RISCV_IRQ_SSOFT         (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 1)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MSOFT         (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 3)
#define RISCV_IRQ_STIMER        (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 5)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER        (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 7)
#define RISCV_IRQ_SEXT          (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 9)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MEXT          (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 11)
```

计算：

```text
RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC = 15 + 1 = 16
RISCV_IRQ_MEXT  = 16 + 11 = 27
```

当前为 M-mode，`RISCV_IRQ_EXT` 是它的别名：

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/include/mode.h:125-129`

```c

#  define RISCV_IRQ_EXT     RISCV_IRQ_MEXT   /* PLIC IRQ */
#  define RISCV_IRQ_TIMER   RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER /* Timer IRQ */
#  define RISCV_IRQ_SOFT    RISCV_IRQ_MSOFT  /* SW IRQ */
```

因此标准 NuttX 语义下：

```text
UART5 source 61 -> logical IRQ 27 + 61 = 88
```

## 2. NuttX 标准 PLIC 实现确实执行 `MEXT + source`

例如 FE310：

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/fe310/fe310_irq_dispatch.c:41-64`

```c
#define RV_IRQ_MASK 27

void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uintreg_t vector, uintreg_t *regs)
{
  int irq = (vector >> RV_IRQ_MASK) | (vector & 0xf);

  /* Firstly, check if the irq is machine external interrupt */

  if (RISCV_IRQ_MEXT == irq)
    {
      uint32_t val = getreg32(FE310_PLIC_CLAIM);

      /* Add the value to nuttx irq which is offset to the mext */

      irq += val;
    }
```

对 RV32 `mcause = 0x8000000b`：

```text

(vector & 0xf) = 11
16 | 11        = 27 = RISCV_IRQ_MEXT
27 + source 61 = 88
```

# 二、NuttX 标准编号语义

## 1. `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT` 的实际数值是 27

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/include/irq.h:107-120`

```c
#ifndef RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION
#  define RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION   (15)
#endif

/* IRQ (RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION + 1)- : (async event:interrupt=1) */

#define RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC         (RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION + 1)
#define RISCV_IRQ_SSOFT         (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 1)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MSOFT         (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 3)
#define RISCV_IRQ_STIMER        (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 5)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER        (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 7)
#define RISCV_IRQ_SEXT          (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 9)
#define RISCV_IRQ_MEXT          (RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC + 11)
```

计算：

```text
RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC = 15 + 1 = 16
RISCV_IRQ_MEXT  = 16 + 11 = 27
```

当前为 M-mode，`RISCV_IRQ_EXT` 是它的别名：

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/include/mode.h:125-129`

```c

#  define RISCV_IRQ_EXT     RISCV_IRQ_MEXT   /* PLIC IRQ */
#  define RISCV_IRQ_TIMER   RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER /* Timer IRQ */
#  define RISCV_IRQ_SOFT    RISCV_IRQ_MSOFT  /* SW IRQ */
```

因此标准 NuttX 语义下：

```text
UART5 source 61 -> logical IRQ 27 + 61 = 88
```

## 2. NuttX 标准 PLIC 实现确实执行 `MEXT + source`

例如 FE310：

`/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/fe310/fe310_irq_dispatch.c:41-64`

```c
{

  /* Firstly, check if the irq is machine external interrupt */

  if (RISCV_IRQ_MEXT == irq)
```

## 4. IER、IRQ 安装/unmask 与 FinSH RX 启用时序

### 4.1 HPMCU IRQ 安装

在 `rt_hw_usart_init()` 中：

```c
rt_hw_interrupt_install(dev->irqNum, uart->irq_handler, RT_NULL, uart_board->name);
rt_hw_interrupt_mask(dev->irqNum);
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:644-652`

以后，在 `rockchip_uart_configure()` 末尾 unmask：

```c
rt_hw_interrupt_umask(dev->irqNum);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:425-437`

SCR1 port 中：

- `rt_hw_interrupt_install()` 写 `irq_desc[vector]`
- `mask()` 调 `rt_hw_interrupt_deactive()`
- `umask()` 调 `rt_hw_interrupt_active()`

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:368-399`

INT_MUX 对 vector 61 的实际位置：

```text
index = 61 / 32 = 1
bit   = 61 % 32 = 29
```

即 RT-Thread 在 `INT_MUX + 4` 的 bit 29 启用/关闭 UART5 中断：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/drivers/int_mux.c:18-36`

### 4.2 IER.RDI 不是首次 console open 直接设置，而是 FinSH 之后设置

`rt_console_set_device("uart5")` 首次只使用：

```c
RT_DEVICE_OFLAG_RDWR | RT_DEVICE_FLAG_STREAM
```

没有 `RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/src/kservice.c:1260-1262`

所以首次 console 打开会执行 configure 和 IRQ unmask，但不会因这个 open 自动触发 `RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT`。

实际 RX interrupt 是 FinSH 线程随后打开 console 设备时启用的：

```c
rt_device_open(dev, RT_DEVICE_OFLAG_RDWR |
               RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX |
               RT_DEVICE_FLAG_STREAM)
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:210-241`

FinSH thread 获取 console 并调用 `finsh_set_device()`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:447-468`

FinSH 被实际链接并导出到 `.rti_fn.6`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:731-800`
- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:6530-6532`

serial V1 core 收到 `RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX` 后，创建 RX FIFO，并调用：

```c
serial->ops->control(serial, RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT,
                     (void *)RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/drivers/serial/serial.c:600-647`

Rockchip UART control 最终做：

```c
HAL_UART_EnableIrq(hw_base, UART_IER_RDI);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:451-469`

HAL 的实际 IER 操作为：

```c
pReg->IER |= UART_IER_RDI;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:390-410`
- `UART_IER_RDI = 0x01`：  
  `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:29-45`

所以实际时序是：

```text
rt_hw_usart_init:
  install IRQ61 -> mask IRQ61

首次 console open:
  HAL_UART_Init -> HPMCU IRQ61 unmask
  但此时不必然 IER.RDI=1

FinSH thread:
  open uart5 with INT_RX
  -> serial core creates RX FIFO
  -> RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT
  -> IER.RDI |= 1
```

## 5. UART5 RX ISR、IIR/USR/RBR 与 pending 清理

### 5.1 IRQ 调用链

```text
IRQ 61
  -> SCR1 m_ext_irq_handle()
  -> irq_desc[61].handler
  -> rockchip_uart5_irq()
  -> rockchip_uart_irq(&serial5)
```

UART5 wrapper由宏生成：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:45-59,81-83`

实际 `rockchip_uart5_irq` 已链接：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:5545-5546`

SCR1 外部中断分发每次只取一个 active vector 并调用一次 handler，不在该层循环扫描所有 IRQ：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:112-134`

### 5.2 IIR 读取

Rockchip UART handler：

```c
iir = HAL_UART_GetIrqID(hw_base);

switch (iir) {
case UART_IIR_RDI:
case UART_IIR_RX_TIMEOUT:
    rt_hw_serial_isr(serial, RT_SERIAL_EVENT_RX_IND);
    break;
...
}
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:475-507`

HAL 读取：

```c
return (pReg->IIR & UART_IIR_MASK);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:184-194`

IIR 类型：

- RDI：`0x04`
- RX timeout：`0x0c`
- RLSI：`0x06`
- BUSY：`0x07`
- NO_INT：`0x01`

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:36-45`

### 5.3 USR / RBR 读取与 RX FIFO drain

RDI 或 RX timeout 不在 `rockchip_uart_irq()` 中直接读 RBR；它交给 serial core。

`rt_hw_serial_isr()` 的 RX 分支有明确 `while (1)`：

```c
while (1)
{
    ch = serial->ops->getc(serial);
    if (ch == -1) break;
    ...
}
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/drivers/serial/serial.c:1302-1359`

`getc()` 调用：

```c
HAL_UART_SerialIn(uart->dev->pReg, &c, 1);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:230-251`

`HAL_UART_SerialIn()`：

```c
if (!(pReg->USR & UART_USR_RX_FIFO_NOT_EMPTY))
    break;

*pdata++ = (uint8_t)pReg->RBR;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:279-302`

`USR.RX_FIFO_NOT_EMPTY = 0x08`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:132-140`

因此：

- **UART front-end ISR 不循环重新读取 IIR。**
- **serial core RX event 会循环读取 USR/RBR，直到硬件 RX FIFO 空。**
- 对 RDI/RX timeout，pending 的主要清理动作是 drain RBR，而不是写 IIR。
- 若 RX FIFO 有多个字节，一次 `rt_hw_serial_isr()` 会把可读字节全部写入 RT-Thread ring buffer。

### 5.4 非 RX pending 的处理不足

未知/IIR 默认分支会调用：

```c
HAL_UART_HandleIrq(hw_base);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:489-503`

该函数：

- MSI：读 `MSR`
- BUSY：读 `USR`
- RLSI：**也读 `MSR`**
- NO_INT：不操作

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:452-480`

这意味着：

1. BUSY pending 有读 `USR` 的清理动作。
2. MSI 有读 `MSR` 的清理动作。
3. 对 `UART_IIR_RLSI`，源码没有读 `LSR`，而是读 `MSR`；从代码可见不能证明 line-status pending 被正确清除。
4. UART front-end 不会在一个 IRQ handler 内循环读取 IIR 直至 `UART_IIR_NO_INT`。
5. SCR1 外部 IRQ 分发本身也不是循环式分发；若 pending 未清，依赖硬件再次拉起 IRQ。

## 6. U-Boot、Linux 与 loader 的 UART5 预配置情况

### U-Boot

产品配置选中的是 `rv1126b_sportcam` U-Boot 配置，但其实际默认 DT 是 `rv1126b-alientek`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/configs/rv1126b_sportcam_defconfig:16-24`
- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/.config:264-265`

U-Boot debug UART 是：

```text
base  = 0x20810000
clock = 24000000
baud  = 1500000
```

不是 UART5 的 `0x211A0000`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/.config:1321,1341-1347`

U-Boot 通用 RV1126B DT 虽定义 UART5，但状态是 disabled：

```dts

    clocks = <&cru SCLK_UART5>, <&cru PCLK_UART5>;
    pinctrl-0 = <&uart5m0_xfer_pins ...>;
    status = "disabled";
};
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/arch/arm/dts/rv1126b.dtsi:2120-2132`

M0 pin group 的定义存在，但 selected board DTS 没有 `&uart5` override 将其改为 `okay`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/arch/arm/dts/rv1126b-pinctrl.dtsi:2027-2045`

结论：**U-Boot 当前配置的 debug console 不是 UART5；从 selected DT 源码看，U-Boot 不会作为 UART5 consumer 去启用其 pinmux/clock。**

### Linux

产品配置选中的 Linux DTS 是 `rv1126b-sportcam`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/device/rockchip/.chips/rv1126b/rv1126b_sportcam_defconfig:17-20`

```dts
    status = "disabled";
};
```

```dts

           <&cru PCLK_HPMCU_MAILBOX>;
pinctrl-0 = <&uart5m0_xfer_pins>;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/kernel-6.1/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rv1126b-sportcam.dts:27-39`


- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/kernel-6.1/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rv1126b-pinctrl.dtsi:2315-2323`

## 4. IER、IRQ 安装/unmask 与 FinSH RX 启用时序

### 4.1 HPMCU IRQ 安装

在 `rt_hw_usart_init()` 中：

```c
rt_hw_interrupt_install(dev->irqNum, uart->irq_handler, RT_NULL, uart_board->name);
rt_hw_interrupt_mask(dev->irqNum);
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:644-652`

以后，在 `rockchip_uart_configure()` 末尾 unmask：

```c
rt_hw_interrupt_umask(dev->irqNum);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:425-437`

SCR1 port 中：

- `rt_hw_interrupt_install()` 写 `irq_desc[vector]`
- `mask()` 调 `rt_hw_interrupt_deactive()`
- `umask()` 调 `rt_hw_interrupt_active()`

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:368-399`

INT_MUX 对 vector 61 的实际位置：

```text
index = 61 / 32 = 1
bit   = 61 % 32 = 29
```

即 RT-Thread 在 `INT_MUX + 4` 的 bit 29 启用/关闭 UART5 中断：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/drivers/int_mux.c:18-36`

### 4.2 IER.RDI 不是首次 console open 直接设置，而是 FinSH 之后设置

`rt_console_set_device("uart5")` 首次只使用：

```c
RT_DEVICE_OFLAG_RDWR | RT_DEVICE_FLAG_STREAM
```

没有 `RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/src/kservice.c:1260-1262`

所以首次 console 打开会执行 configure 和 IRQ unmask，但不会因这个 open 自动触发 `RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT`。

实际 RX interrupt 是 FinSH 线程随后打开 console 设备时启用的：

```c
rt_device_open(dev, RT_DEVICE_OFLAG_RDWR |
               RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX |
               RT_DEVICE_FLAG_STREAM)
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:210-241`

FinSH thread 获取 console 并调用 `finsh_set_device()`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:447-468`

FinSH 被实际链接并导出到 `.rti_fn.6`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/finsh/shell.c:731-800`
- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:6530-6532`

serial V1 core 收到 `RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX` 后，创建 RX FIFO，并调用：

```c
serial->ops->control(serial, RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT,
                     (void *)RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/drivers/serial/serial.c:600-647`

Rockchip UART control 最终做：

```c
HAL_UART_EnableIrq(hw_base, UART_IER_RDI);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:451-469`

HAL 的实际 IER 操作为：

```c
pReg->IER |= UART_IER_RDI;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:390-410`
- `UART_IER_RDI = 0x01`：  
  `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:29-45`

所以实际时序是：

```text
rt_hw_usart_init:
  install IRQ61 -> mask IRQ61

首次 console open:
  HAL_UART_Init -> HPMCU IRQ61 unmask
  但此时不必然 IER.RDI=1

FinSH thread:
  open uart5 with INT_RX
  -> serial core creates RX FIFO
  -> RT_DEVICE_CTRL_SET_INT
  -> IER.RDI |= 1
```

## 5. UART5 RX ISR、IIR/USR/RBR 与 pending 清理

### 5.1 IRQ 调用链

```text
IRQ 61
  -> SCR1 m_ext_irq_handle()
  -> irq_desc[61].handler
  -> rockchip_uart5_irq()
  -> rockchip_uart_irq(&serial5)
```

UART5 wrapper由宏生成：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:45-59,81-83`

实际 `rockchip_uart5_irq` 已链接：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/rv1126b-mcu/rtthread.map:5545-5546`

SCR1 外部中断分发每次只取一个 active vector 并调用一次 handler，不在该层循环扫描所有 IRQ：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/libcpu/risc-v/scr1/interrupt.c:112-134`

### 5.2 IIR 读取

Rockchip UART handler：

```c
iir = HAL_UART_GetIrqID(hw_base);

switch (iir) {
case UART_IIR_RDI:
case UART_IIR_RX_TIMEOUT:
    rt_hw_serial_isr(serial, RT_SERIAL_EVENT_RX_IND);
    break;
...
}
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:475-507`

HAL 读取：

```c
return (pReg->IIR & UART_IIR_MASK);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:184-194`

IIR 类型：

- RDI：`0x04`
- RX timeout：`0x0c`
- RLSI：`0x06`
- BUSY：`0x07`
- NO_INT：`0x01`

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:36-45`

### 5.3 USR / RBR 读取与 RX FIFO drain

RDI 或 RX timeout 不在 `rockchip_uart_irq()` 中直接读 RBR；它交给 serial core。

`rt_hw_serial_isr()` 的 RX 分支有明确 `while (1)`：

```c
while (1)
{
    ch = serial->ops->getc(serial);
    if (ch == -1) break;
    ...
}
```

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/components/drivers/serial/serial.c:1302-1359`

`getc()` 调用：

```c
HAL_UART_SerialIn(uart->dev->pReg, &c, 1);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:230-251`

`HAL_UART_SerialIn()`：

```c
if (!(pReg->USR & UART_USR_RX_FIFO_NOT_EMPTY))
    break;

*pdata++ = (uint8_t)pReg->RBR;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:279-302`

`USR.RX_FIFO_NOT_EMPTY = 0x08`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/inc/hal_uart.h:132-140`

因此：

- **UART front-end ISR 不循环重新读取 IIR。**
- **serial core RX event 会循环读取 USR/RBR，直到硬件 RX FIFO 空。**
- 对 RDI/RX timeout，pending 的主要清理动作是 drain RBR，而不是写 IIR。
- 若 RX FIFO 有多个字节，一次 `rt_hw_serial_isr()` 会把可读字节全部写入 RT-Thread ring buffer。

### 5.4 非 RX pending 的处理不足

未知/IIR 默认分支会调用：

```c
HAL_UART_HandleIrq(hw_base);
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/drivers/drv_uart.c:489-503`

该函数：

- MSI：读 `MSR`
- BUSY：读 `USR`
- RLSI：**也读 `MSR`**
- NO_INT：不操作

证据：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/rtos/bsp/rockchip/common/hal/lib/hal/src/hal_uart.c:452-480`

这意味着：

1. BUSY pending 有读 `USR` 的清理动作。
2. MSI 有读 `MSR` 的清理动作。
3. 对 `UART_IIR_RLSI`，源码没有读 `LSR`，而是读 `MSR`；从代码可见不能证明 line-status pending 被正确清除。
4. UART front-end 不会在一个 IRQ handler 内循环读取 IIR 直至 `UART_IIR_NO_INT`。
5. SCR1 外部 IRQ 分发本身也不是循环式分发；若 pending 未清，依赖硬件再次拉起 IRQ。

## 6. U-Boot、Linux 与 loader 的 UART5 预配置情况

### U-Boot

产品配置选中的是 `rv1126b_sportcam` U-Boot 配置，但其实际默认 DT 是 `rv1126b-alientek`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/configs/rv1126b_sportcam_defconfig:16-24`
- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/.config:264-265`

U-Boot debug UART 是：

```text
base  = 0x20810000
clock = 24000000
baud  = 1500000
```

不是 UART5 的 `0x211A0000`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/.config:1321,1341-1347`

U-Boot 通用 RV1126B DT 虽定义 UART5，但状态是 disabled：

```dts
uart5: serial@211a0000 {
    clocks = <&cru SCLK_UART5>, <&cru PCLK_UART5>;
    pinctrl-0 = <&uart5m0_xfer_pins ...>;
    status = "disabled";
};
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/arch/arm/dts/rv1126b.dtsi:2120-2132`

M0 pin group 的定义存在，但 selected board DTS 没有 `&uart5` override 将其改为 `okay`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/u-boot/arch/arm/dts/rv1126b-pinctrl.dtsi:2027-2045`

结论：**U-Boot 当前配置的 debug console 不是 UART5；从 selected DT 源码看，U-Boot 不会作为 UART5 consumer 去启用其 pinmux/clock。**

### Linux

产品配置选中的 Linux DTS 是 `rv1126b-sportcam`：

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/device/rockchip/.chips/rv1126b/rv1126b_sportcam_defconfig:17-20`

Linux 普通 UART5 节点也是 disabled：

```dts
&uart5 {
    status = "disabled";
};
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/kernel-6.1/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rv1126b-sportcam.dts:19-25`

因此 Linux 8250/DW UART 驱动不会把 UART5 作为 Linux tty 配置。

但 Linux 的 `rockchip_amp` 节点明确把 UART5 的资源给 HPMCU RT-Thread console：

```dts
clocks = ... <&cru SCLK_UART5>, <&cru PCLK_UART5>,
           <&cru PCLK_HPMCU_MAILBOX>;
pinctrl-0 = <&uart5m0_xfer_pins>;
```

- `/home/lijian/project/rv1126b/rv1126bsportCam/sdk/atk_dlrv1126b_linux6.1_sdk/kernel-6.1/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rv1126b-sportcam.dts:27-39`

Linux pinctrl 指定：

```dts
UART5_RX_M0 = GPIO4_PA7 FUNC5 pull-up
```

```text

bit                    = 61 % 32 = 29
```

```c
110	{

112	   * CLKSEL_CON14 at TOPCRU + 0x338:
113	   *   Bits [15:13] = SCLK_UART5_SRC_SEL (0 = XIN_OSC0 / 24 MHz)

116	   * affected.
```

    sw      x17, 17 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a7 */
    sw      x18, 18 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s2 */
    sw      x19, 19 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s3 */
    sw      x20, 20 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s4 */
    sw      x21, 21 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s5 */

    sw      x24, 24 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s8 */
    sw      x25, 25 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s9 */
    sw      x26, 26 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s10 */
    sw      x27, 27 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s11 */
    sw      x28, 28 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t3 */
    sw      x29, 29 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t4 */
    sw      x30, 30 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t5 */
    sw      x31, 31 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t6 */

    /* Save mepc into slot 0 (REG_EPC).
     * NuttX riscv_doirq_top() reads regs[REG_EPC] to advance PC on ecall;
     * on context switch, the scheduler returns a different task's regs and
     * this value is written back to mepc below.
     */

    csrr    t0, mepc
    sw      t0, REG_EPC(sp)

    /* Save mstatus into slot 32 (REG_INT_CTX).
     * Contains MIE/MPIE/MPP bits needed across context switches.
     * Matches NuttX convention for non-CLIC, non-shadow-stack configs.
     */

    csrr    t0, mstatus
    sw      t0, REG_INT_CTX(sp)

    /* Pass context pointer (sp) as second argument (a1) and
     * mcause as first argument (a0) to the C dispatch function.
     *
     * Prototype: void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uintptr_t mcause,
     *                                     uintreg_t *regs);
     * Returns: pointer to the (possibly new) register context.
     */

    mv      a1, sp
    csrr    a0, mcause
    call    riscv_dispatch_irq

    /* riscv_dispatch_irq / riscv_doirq may switch context:
     * a0 now points to the register frame of the task to resume.
     */

    mv      sp, a0

    /* Restore mepc from slot 0 (REG_EPC) */

    lw      t0, REG_EPC(sp)
    csrw    mepc, t0

    /* Restore mstatus from slot 32 (REG_INT_CTX) */

    lw      t0, REG_INT_CTX(sp)
    csrw    mstatus, t0

    /* Restore all general-purpose registers except x2/sp first.
     * Keep sp pointing at the context frame until the final load.
     */

    lw      x1,  1 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* ra */
    lw      x3,  3 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* gp */
    lw      x4,  4 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* tp */
    lw      x5,  5 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* t0 */
    lw      x6,  6 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* t1 */
    lw      x7,  7 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* t2 */
    lw      x8,  8 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* s0/fp */
    lw      x9,  9 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* s1 */
    lw      x10, 10 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a0 */
    lw      x11, 11 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a1 */
    lw      x12, 12 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a2 */
    lw      x13, 13 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a3 */
    lw      x14, 14 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a4 */
    lw      x15, 15 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a5 */
    lw      x16, 16 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a6 */
    lw      x17, 17 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* a7 */
    lw      x18, 18 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s2 */
    lw      x19, 19 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s3 */
    lw      x20, 20 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s4 */
    lw      x21, 21 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s5 */
    lw      x22, 22 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s6 */
    lw      x23, 23 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s7 */
    lw      x24, 24 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s8 */
    lw      x25, 25 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s9 */
    lw      x26, 26 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s10 */
    lw      x27, 27 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* s11 */
    lw      x28, 28 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t3 */
    lw      x29, 29 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t4 */
    lw      x30, 30 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t5 */
    lw      x31, 31 * REGBYTES(sp)  /* t6 */
    lw      x2,  2 * REGBYTES(sp)   /* sp -- restore last */

    /* Return from trap -- mepc and mstatus already restored above */

    mret

    .size   g_traps, . - g_traps

  .section      .text.entry

trap_entry:

    // save all from thread context
    addi sp, sp, -32 * 4

    sw x1,   1 * 4(sp)

    sw x4,   4 * 4(sp)
    sw x5,   5 * 4(sp)

    sw x29, 29 * 4(sp)
    sw x30, 30 * 4(sp)
    sw x31, 31 * 4(sp)

    li t0, 0x80
    sw t0,   2 * 4(sp)

    // switch to interrupt stack
    move s0, sp
    la   sp, _sp

    // interrupt handle
    call rt_interrupt_enter
    csrr a0, mcause
    csrr a1, mepc
    mv a2, s0
    call handle_trap
    call rt_interrupt_leave

    // switch to from thread stack
    move sp, s0

    // need to switch new thread
    la   s0, rt_thread_switch_interrupt_flag
    lw   s2, 0(s0)
    beqz s2, spurious_interrupt
    sw   zero, 0(s0)

    sw   sp, 0(s1)

    lw   s1, 0(s0)
    lw   sp, 0(s1)

    csrw mepc, a0

/****************************************************************************

 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __BOARD_HARDWARE_RV1126B_UART_H
#define __BOARD_HARDWARE_RV1126B_UART_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* UART register offsets (DesignWare 8250-compatible) */

#define RV1126B_UART_RBR_OFFSET       0x0000  /* Receive Buffer Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_THR_OFFSET       0x0000  /* Transmit Holding Register (write) */
#define RV1126B_UART_DLL_OFFSET       0x0000  /* Divisor Latch Low (when DLAB=1) */
#define RV1126B_UART_DLH_OFFSET       0x0004  /* Divisor Latch High (when DLAB=1) */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_OFFSET       0x0004  /* Interrupt Enable Register (when DLAB=0) */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_OFFSET       0x0008  /* Interrupt Identification Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_OFFSET       0x0008  /* FIFO Control Register (write) */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_OFFSET       0x000C  /* Line Control Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_OFFSET       0x0010  /* Modem Control Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_OFFSET       0x0014  /* Line Status Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_MSR_OFFSET       0x0018  /* Modem Status Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_SCR_OFFSET       0x001C  /* Scratch Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRBR_OFFSET      0x0030  /* Shadow Receive Buffer Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_STHR_OFFSET      0x0030  /* Shadow Transmit Holding Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_FAR_OFFSET       0x0070  /* FIFO Access Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_TFR_OFFSET       0x0074  /* Transmit FIFO Read (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_RFW_OFFSET       0x0078  /* Receive FIFO Write (write) */
#define RV1126B_UART_USR_OFFSET       0x007C  /* UART Status Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_TFL_OFFSET       0x0080  /* Transmit FIFO Level (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_RFL_OFFSET       0x0084  /* Receive FIFO Level (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRR_OFFSET       0x0088  /* Software Reset Register (write) */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRTS_OFFSET      0x008C  /* Shadow Request to Send */
#define RV1126B_UART_SBCR_OFFSET      0x0090  /* Shadow Break Control Register */
#define RV1126B_UART_SDMAM_OFFSET     0x0094  /* Shadow DMA Mode */
#define RV1126B_UART_SFE_OFFSET       0x0098  /* Shadow FIFO Enable */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRT_OFFSET       0x009C  /* Shadow RCVR Trigger */
#define RV1126B_UART_STET_OFFSET      0x00A0  /* Shadow TX Empty Trigger */
#define RV1126B_UART_HTX_OFFSET       0x00A4  /* Halt TX */
#define RV1126B_UART_DMASA_OFFSET     0x00A8  /* DMA Software Acknowledge (write) */
#define RV1126B_UART_CPR_OFFSET       0x00F4  /* Component Parameter Register (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_UCV_OFFSET       0x00F8  /* UART Component Version (read) */
#define RV1126B_UART_CTR_OFFSET       0x00FC  /* Component Type Register (read) */

/* IER bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_IER_ERBFI        (1 << 0)  /* Enable Received Data Available Interrupt */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_ETBEI        (1 << 1)  /* Enable Transmit Holding Register Empty Int */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_ELSI         (1 << 2)  /* Enable Receiver Line Status Interrupt */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_EDSSI        (1 << 3)  /* Enable Modem Status Interrupt */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_ELCOLR       (1 << 4)  /* Enable Low-power Setting Interrupt */
#define RV1126B_UART_IER_PTIME        (1 << 7)  /* Programmable THRE Interrupt Mode Enable */

/* IIR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_NONE         0x01      /* No interrupt pending */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_ID_MASK      0x0e      /* Interrupt ID mask */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_MSI          0x00      /* Modem Status */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_THRE         0x02      /* Transmit Holding Register Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_RDA          0x04      /* Received Data Available */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_RLS          0x06      /* Receiver Line Status */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_BUSY         0x07      /* Busy Detect */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_CTI          0x0C      /* Character Timeout */
#define RV1126B_UART_IIR_FEFLAG       0x80      /* FIFOs Enable Flag */

/* FCR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE        (1 << 0)  /* FIFO Enable */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_RFIFOR       (1 << 1)  /* Receiver FIFO Reset */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_XFIFOR       (1 << 2)  /* Transmitter FIFO Reset */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_HALF     (0 << 4)  /* TX FIFO Trigger: Half */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_QUARTER  (1 << 4)  /* TX FIFO Trigger: Quarter (not empty) */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_TWO      (2 << 4)  /* TX FIFO Trigger: 2 entries */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_EMPTY    (3 << 4)  /* TX FIFO Trigger: Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_ONE       (0 << 6)  /* RX FIFO Trigger: 1 entry */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_QUARTER   (1 << 6)  /* RX FIFO Trigger: Quarter */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_HALF      (2 << 6)  /* RX FIFO Trigger: Half */
#define RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_TWO_LESS  (3 << 6)  /* RX FIFO Trigger: 2 less than full */

/* LCR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_DLS_5        0x00      /* Data Length: 5 bits */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_DLS_6        0x01      /* Data Length: 6 bits */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_DLS_7        0x02      /* Data Length: 7 bits */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_DLS_8        0x03      /* Data Length: 8 bits */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_STOP_1       (0 << 2)  /* 1 Stop Bit */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_STOP_2       (1 << 2)  /* 1.5 or 2 Stop Bits */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_PEN          (1 << 3)  /* Parity Enable */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_EPS          (1 << 4)  /* Even Parity Select */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_SP           (1 << 5)  /* Stick Parity */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_BC           (1 << 6)  /* Break Control */
#define RV1126B_UART_LCR_DLAB         (1 << 7)  /* Divisor Latch Access Bit */

/* MCR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_DTR          (1 << 0)  /* Data Terminal Ready */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_RTS          (1 << 1)  /* Request to Send */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_OUT1         (1 << 2)  /* Out 1 */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_OUT2         (1 << 3)  /* Out 2 */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_LOOPBACK     (1 << 4)  /* Loopback Mode */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_AFCE         (1 << 5)  /* Auto Flow Control Enable */
#define RV1126B_UART_MCR_SIRE         (1 << 6)  /* SIR Mode Enable */

/* LSR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_DR           (1 << 0)  /* Data Ready */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_OE           (1 << 1)  /* Overrun Error */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_PE           (1 << 2)  /* Parity Error */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_FE           (1 << 3)  /* Framing Error */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_BI           (1 << 4)  /* Break Interrupt */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_THRE         (1 << 5)  /* Transmit Holding Register Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_TEMT         (1 << 6)  /* Transmitter Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_LSR_RFE          (1 << 7)  /* Receiver FIFO Error */

/* USR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_USR_BUSY         (1 << 0)  /* UART Busy */
#define RV1126B_UART_USR_TFNF         (1 << 1)  /* Transmit FIFO Not Full */
#define RV1126B_UART_USR_TFE          (1 << 2)  /* Transmit FIFO Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_USR_RFNE         (1 << 3)  /* Receive FIFO Not Empty */
#define RV1126B_UART_USR_RFF          (1 << 4)  /* Receive FIFO Full */

/* SRR bit definitions */

#define RV1126B_UART_SRR_UR           (1 << 0)  /* UART Reset */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRR_RFR          (1 << 1)  /* Receiver FIFO Reset */
#define RV1126B_UART_SRR_XFR          (1 << 2)  /* Transmitter FIFO Reset */

#endif /* __BOARD_HARDWARE_RV1126B_UART_H */

建议在 `rv1126b_irq.c` 本地定义：

```c
#define RV1126B_IPIC_VECTOR_COUNT  16
#define RV1126B_IPIC_ICSR_IE       (1u << 1) /* 0x02 */
```

然后使用与现有 helper 相同的字面量 CSR 调用：

```c
for (i = 0; i < RV1126B_IPIC_VECTOR_COUNT; i++)
  {
    write_csr(0xbf6, i);                  /* IPIC_IDX */
    write_csr(0xbf7, RV1126B_IPIC_ICSR_IE); /* IPIC_ICSR.IE */

```

## 4. FCR 对齐到 `0xA1`

当前两处都只写了 FIFO clear 值 `0x07`：

- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_lowputc.c:221-224`
- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c:255-258`

现有 header 已具备全部所需 bit 定义，无需修改：

- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/hardware/rv1126b_uart.h:70-80`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE = 0x01`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_TWO = 0x20`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_HALF = 0x80`

最终值为：

```text
0x01 | 0x20 | 0x80 = 0xA1
```

两处均应采用两步：

```c
/* First flush stale FIFOs. */

putreg32(RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_RFIFOR |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_XFIFOR, UART_FCR(base));

/* Then leave the required steady-state FCR value: 0xA1. */

putreg32(RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_TWO |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_HALF, UART_FCR(base));
```

所以答案是：**先 clear FIFO，再显式最终写 `0xA1`。** 两处都必须改，因为 full serial setup 会在 lowsetup 之后再次 software-reset 并覆盖 FCR。

建议在 `rv1126b_irq.c` 本地定义：

```c
#define RV1126B_IPIC_VECTOR_COUNT  16
#define RV1126B_IPIC_ICSR_IE       (1u << 1) /* 0x02 */
```

然后使用与现有 helper 相同的字面量 CSR 调用：

```c
for (i = 0; i < RV1126B_IPIC_VECTOR_COUNT; i++)
  {
    write_csr(0xbf6, i);                  /* IPIC_IDX */
    write_csr(0xbf7, RV1126B_IPIC_ICSR_IE); /* IPIC_ICSR.IE */
  }
```

## 4. FCR 对齐到 `0xA1`

当前两处都只写了 FIFO clear 值 `0x07`：

- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_lowputc.c:221-224`
- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c:255-258`

现有 header 已具备全部所需 bit 定义，无需修改：

- `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/hardware/rv1126b_uart.h:70-80`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE = 0x01`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_TWO = 0x20`
  - `RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_HALF = 0x80`

最终值为：

```text
0x01 | 0x20 | 0x80 = 0xA1
```

两处均应采用两步：

```c
/* First flush stale FIFOs. */

putreg32(RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_RFIFOR |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_XFIFOR, UART_FCR(base));

/* Then leave the required steady-state FCR value: 0xA1. */

putreg32(RV1126B_UART_FCR_FIFOE |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_TFT_TWO |
         RV1126B_UART_FCR_RT_HALF, UART_FCR(base));
```

所以答案是：**先 clear FIFO，再显式最终写 `0xA1`。** 两处都必须改，因为 full serial setup 会在 lowsetup 之后再次 software-reset 并覆盖 FCR。

81	/****************************************************************************
82	 * Name: rv1126b_timer_stop
83	 *
84	 * Description:
85	 *   Stop the MTIME timer by clearing the enable bit.
86	 *
87	 ****************************************************************************/
88	
89	static void rv1126b_timer_stop(void)
90	{
91	  uint32_t regval;
92	
93	  regval = getreg32(CTIMER_MTIME_CTRL);
94	  regval &= ~RV1126B_MTIME_CTRL_EN;
95	  putreg32(regval, CTIMER_MTIME_CTRL);
96	}
97	
98	/****************************************************************************
99	 * Name: rv1126b_timer_start
100	 *
101	 * Description:
102	 *   Start the MTIME timer by setting the enable bit.
103	 *
104	 ****************************************************************************/
105	
106	static void rv1126b_timer_start(void)
107	{
108	  uint32_t regval;
109	
110	  regval = getreg32(CTIMER_MTIME_CTRL);
111	  regval |= RV1126B_MTIME_CTRL_EN;
112	  putreg32(regval, CTIMER_MTIME_CTRL);
113	}
114	
115	static int g_tick_count = 0;
116	
117	/****************************************************************************
118	 * Public Functions
119	 ****************************************************************************/
120	
121	/****************************************************************************
122	 * Name: up_timer_initialize
123	 *
124	 * Description:
125	 *   Configure the MTIME timer to generate periodic system tick interrupts
126	 *   at 100 Hz (CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK = 10000 usec).
127	 *
128	 *   This function is called during early OS initialization before the
129	 *   scheduler is started.
130	 *
131	 ****************************************************************************/
132	
133	void up_timer_initialize(void)
134	{
135	  riscv_lowputc('T');
136	
137	  /* Stop the timer first */
138	
139	  rv1126b_timer_stop();
140	
141	  /* Reset MTIME counter to 0 */
142	
143	  putreg32(0, CTIMER_MTIME);
144	  putreg32(0, CTIMER_MTIMEH);
145	
146	  /* Reset MTIMECMP to 0 */
147	
148	  putreg32(0, CTIMER_MTIMECMP);
149	  putreg32(0, CTIMER_MTIMECMPH);
150	
151	  /* Set the divider to divide the core clock by 1000 */
152	
153	  putreg32(RV1126B_MTIME_DIV_VALUE, CTIMER_MTIME_DIV);
154	
155	  /* Set MTIMECMP to the first tick value */
156	
157	  putreg32(RV1126B_MTIME_TICK_VALUE, CTIMER_MTIMECMP);
158	  putreg32(0, CTIMER_MTIMECMPH);
159	
160	  /* Enable the MIP_MTIP bit in the mie CSR to allow timer interrupts */
161	
162	  set_csr(mie, MIP_MTIP);
163	
164	  /* Start the timer */
165	
166	  rv1126b_timer_start();
167	  riscv_lowputc('t');
168	}
169	
170	/****************************************************************************
171	 * Name: up_timer_int
172	 *
173	 * Description:
174	 *   Advance the MTIMECMP register by one tick period.  This is called
175	 *   from the timer interrupt handler to acknowledge the interrupt and
176	 *   schedule the next tick.
177	 *
178	 ****************************************************************************/
179	
180	void up_timer_int(void)
181	{
182	  uint64_t mtime;
183	  uint64_t mtimecmp;
184	
185	  /* Temporarily disable timer interrupt to avoid race condition */
186	
187	  clear_csr(mie, MIP_MTIP);
188	
189	  /* Read current mtime and advance compare from it (not from old mtimecmp) */
190	
191	  mtime = (uint64_t)getreg32(CTIMER_MTIMEH) << 32;
192	  mtime |= getreg32(CTIMER_MTIME);
193	  mtimecmp = mtime + g_mtimecmp_step;
194	
195	  /* Write new MTIMECMP value */
196	
197	  putreg32((uint32_t)(mtimecmp & 0xffffffff), CTIMER_MTIMECMP);
198	  putreg32((uint32_t)(mtimecmp >> 32), CTIMER_MTIMECMPH);
199	
200	  /* One-time diagnostic marker for first 3 ticks */
201	
202	  if (g_tick_count < 3)
203	    {
204	      riscv_lowputc('!');
205	      g_tick_count++;
206	    }
207	
208	  rv1126b_uart_poll();
209	
210	  /* Process the OS tick */
211	
212	  nxsched_process_timer();
213	
214	  /* Re-enable timer interrupt */
215	
216	  set_csr(mie, MIP_MTIP);
217	}

# RV1126B UART5 clean IRQ alignment plan

## Context

The current UART5 bring-up has accumulated intrusive `V3/A/R/I/P/F/E/U/K/Q/q` diagnostics plus timer/idle polling. With `CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=0`, those probes alter task/idle stack use, BSS layout, UART timing, and scheduler state; the latest corrupted `g_inactivetasks.head` result is therefore not a trustworthy root-cause signal.

A source-and-map comparison against the SDK's actually linked **RT-Thread SportCam/UART5** image established that UART5 base/clock/pinmux/baud/raw IRQ 61/INTMUX mapping are already substantially correct. The concrete missing initialization is RT-Thread's SCR1 IPIC setup: enabling IPIC vectors 0..15 through CSR `0xbf6` (IDX) and `0xbf7` (ICSR.IE). The goal is one clean implementation, one build/package cycle, and one board test—without further stacked instrumentation.

All product changes stay inside `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/`; do not modify official `nuttx/`, `apps/`, `packages/`, or generated `vendor/` checkouts.

## Implementation

### 1. Restore a clean interrupt controller path

Modify `board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_irq.c`:

- Keep the existing raw hardware-source IRQ model. UART5 remains IRQ `61`; do **not** change it to `RISCV_IRQ_MEXT + 61`.
- After clearing all INTMUX enables in `up_irqinitialize()`, and before enabling `mie.MEIP`/global MIE, reproduce the linked RT-Thread SCR1 initialization:
  - for indices `0..15`, write the index to literal CSR `0xbf6`;
  - write `1u << 1` to literal CSR `0xbf7` to set `IPIC_ICSR_IE`.
- Pass CSR numbers as literals because `write_csr()` in `chip/chip.h` stringifies its first argument.
- Preserve the existing INTMUX group enable/disable logic and IPIC SOI/EOI handshake.

### 2. Align UART steady-state setup with RT-Thread

Modify both UART initialization sites:

- `board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_lowputc.c::rv1126b_uart5_init_hw()`
- `board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c::rv1126b_uart_setup()`

At each site:

1. retain the FIFO flush write (`FIFOE | RFIFOR | XFIFOR`);
2. follow it with the RT-Thread steady-state FCR value `FIFOE | TFT_TWO | RT_HALF` (`0xa1`).

Keep the verified 24 MHz clock, divisor 1, 1.5 Mbps, 8N1, GPIO4_PA6/PA7 FUNC5, pull-up, reset, and `IER.ERBFI` behavior unchanged.

### 3. Remove intrusive diagnostics and RX polling bypasses

Clean the temporary diagnostics while preserving functional paths:

- `chip/rv1126b_serial.c`
  - remove diagnostic globals/helpers and attach/rxint/ISR/registration marker output;
  - remove `rv1126b_uart_poll()` and all RX ring-buffer/CSR probes;
  - remove `g_rv1126b_rx_poll_enabled` coupling from `rxint()`;
  - preserve `irq_attach()`, `up_enable_irq()`, IER updates, `rv1126b_uart_interrupt()`, `uart_recvchars()`, and both `uart_register()` calls;
  - replace the TX workaround's outer `while (uart_txready())` loop with the normal NuttX kick pattern: enable/write `IER.ETBEI`, then call `uart_xmitchars(dev)` once. Do not remove TX priming entirely.

- `chip/rv1126b_timerisr.c`
  - remove timer marker characters, the diagnostic tick counter, the `rv1126b_uart_poll()` declaration, and the polling call;
  - preserve MTIME acknowledge/re-arm, `nxsched_process_timer()`, and MTIP mask/unmask.

- Delete `chip/rv1126b_idle.c`, which exists solely as no-WFI UART polling/diagnostic fallback.

- `chip/Make.defs`

117	 *
118	 * Description:
119	 *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem for the RV1126B HPMCU.
120	 *   - Disable all INTMUX enables
121	 *   - Set mtvec to the trap vector
122	 *   - Enable machine external interrupts in MIE
123	 *   - Enable global interrupts
124	 *
125	 ****************************************************************************/
126	
127	void up_irqinitialize(void)
128	{
129	  int i;
130	
131	  /* Disable all INTMUX interrupt enables */
132	
133	  for (i = 0; i < INTMUX_NGROUPS; i++)

136	                (i * RV1126B_INTMUX_GROUP_STRIDE));

138	
139	  /* Enable all IPIC vectors before enabling MEIP.  write_csr() stringifies
140	   * its CSR argument, so these CSR numbers must remain literals.
141	   */
142	
143	  for (i = 0; i < 16; i++)

150	   * (g_traps in rv1126b_head.S) before NuttX code runs.

153	  /* Enable machine external interrupts (MEIP) in the mie CSR */
154	
155	  set_csr(mie, MIP_MEIP);
156	
157	  /* Enable global interrupts */
158	
159	  up_irq_enable();

# openvela Build

编译 openvela 固件、修改内核配置、运行模拟器。

## 默认目标

默认编译目标为 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap（64 位 ARM 模拟器）：

```
CONFIG_PATH=vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
OUTPUT_DIR=cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

如果用户指定了其他板级配置路径，替换上述路径即可。

## 命令

### 编译

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

示例：
```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

**成功标志**: 输出 `#### build completed successfully`

**编译产物**: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/nuttx`（ELF）、`<OUTPUT_DIR>/vela_ap.bin`

### 修改内核配置（menuconfig）

```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake menuconfig
```

menuconfig 是交互式 TUI 界面，**不能在 AI 终端中直接运行**。提示用户在自己的终端中执行。

修改配置后保存会自动更新 `.config`。如需持久化到 defconfig：
```bash
./build.sh <CONFIG_PATH> --cmake savedefconfig
```

### 运行模拟器

```bash
./emulator.sh <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

示例：
```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/
```

**成功标志**: 出现 `goldfish-armv8a-ap>` NSH 提示符

### 清理编译

```bash
rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>
```

全量清理后重新编译：
```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ && ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -j$(nproc)
```

## 编译流程

1. 用户指定或确认目标配置路径
2. 执行 `./build.sh <path> --cmake -j$(nproc)`
3. 检查输出最后几行是否包含 `build completed successfully`
4. 如果编译失败，分析错误日志并尝试修复（最多 3 轮）

## 编译失败处理

| 错误类型 | 特征 | 处理 |
|----------|------|------|
| 代码错误 | `error:` + 本驱动文件名 | 自动修复代码，重新编译 |
| 配置缺失 | `undefined reference` + CONFIG 相关 | 提示用户 menuconfig 开启 |
| 工具链问题 | `command not found` | 提示用户安装工具链 |
| 缓存问题 | 奇怪的链接错误 | `rm -rf <OUTPUT_DIR>` 后重编 |

## 启用新驱动的 CONFIG

如果需要临时启用某个 CONFIG 进行编译验证：

```bash
# 方法 1: 直接追加到 defconfig（推荐）
echo "CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y" >> <CONFIG_PATH>/defconfig

# 方法 2: 用 sed 修改 .config（临时，不持久化）
sed -i 's/# CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680 is not set/CONFIG_SENSORS_BME680=y/' <OUTPUT_DIR>/.config
```

修改后重新编译即可。

## 常用配置路径

| 目标 | 配置路径 |
|------|----------|
| goldfish-arm64 (推荐) | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/` |
| goldfish-arm32 | `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-armeabi-v7a-ap/` |
| 自定义板级 | `vendor/<vendor>/boards/<chip>/<board>/configs/<config>/` |

已完成。现在是一个**干净、无插桩、对齐 RT-Thread 的版本**，并且只执行了一次完整构建和打包。

## 核心修复

- 补上 RT-Thread 已有的 SCR1 IPIC 初始化：循环使能 16 个 IPIC 通道，写 CSR `0xbf6/0xbf7`  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_irq.c:127`
- 保持 UART5 使用 **raw IRQ 61**，没有错误改成 IRQ 88  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c:53`
- UART 两处初始化均先清 FIFO，再设置 RT-Thread 同款稳定值 `FCR=0xa1`  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_lowputc.c:223`  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c:207`
- TX 改为标准 NuttX 模式：先写 `IER.ETBEI`，再调用一次 `uart_xmitchars()` 启动发送，不再循环轮询  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/rv1126b_serial.c:415`
- 删除 timer RX polling、idle RX polling、Q/q ring-buffer 探针及全部字符诊断。
- 删除 `rv1126b_idle.c`，恢复通用 RISC-V `wfi` idle  
  `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/contest_board/chip/Make.defs:6`

## 构建和 ELF 验证

`distclean` 和完整构建均成功，未重试。

最终 ELF 已确认：

- `up_irqinitialize`、`riscv_dispatch_irq`、`rv1126b_uart_interrupt` 均已链接。
- 反汇编包含：
  - `csrw 0xbf6`
  - `csrwi 0xbf7, 2`
  - 16 次循环
  - 且位于 `mie.MEIP` 和全局 MIE 开启之前。
- `rv1126b_uart_poll` 已不存在。
- `rv1126b_idle.o` 未链接。
- `up_idle` 来自通用 `riscv_idle.o`，指令为 `wfi`。
- 最终对象中 UART IRQ 字段仍为十六进制 `0x3d`，即 61。

`/simplify → 4 cleanup agents in parallel → apply the fixes`

You are improving the quality of the changed code, not hunting for bugs. Review
it for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then fix what you
find. Do not look for correctness bugs — that is what `/code-review` is for.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Review (4 cleanup agents in parallel)

Launch **4 independent review agents** via the Agent tool, all in a
single message so they run concurrently. Pass each agent the diff and one of
the four angles below. Each returns its findings with `file`, `line`, a
one-line `summary`, and the concrete cost (what is duplicated, wasted, or
harder to maintain).

### Reuse

Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

## Phase 2 — Apply the fixes

Wait for all four agents to complete, dedup findings that point at the same
line or mechanism, and fix each remaining one directly. Skip any finding whose
fix would change intended behavior, require changes well outside the reviewed
diff, or that you judge to be a false positive — note the skip rather than
arguing with it. Finish with a brief summary of what was fixed and what was
skipped (or confirm the code was already clean).

#ifndef __BOARD_CHIP_CHIP_H
#define __BOARD_CHIP_CHIP_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/config.h>

/* Hardware register definitions */

#include "hardware/rv1126b_memorymap.h"
#include "hardware/rv1126b_intmux.h"
#include "hardware/rv1126b_timer.h"
#include "hardware/rv1126b_uart.h"
#include "hardware/rv1126b_cru.h"

/****************************************************************************
 * RISC-V CSR Helper Macros
 *
 * These are needed for inline CSR access in C code (set_csr, clear_csr,
 * read_csr, write_csr).  They follow the same pattern as the SDK
 * riscv_csr_encoding.h.
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __ASSEMBLY__

#ifdef __GNUC__

#define read_csr(reg) \
  ({ unsigned long __tmp; \
     asm volatile ("csrr %0, " #reg : "=r"(__tmp)); \
     __tmp; })

#define write_csr(reg, val) \
  ({ asm volatile ("csrw " #reg ", %0" :: "rK"(val)); })

#define set_csr(reg, bit) \
  ({ unsigned long __tmp; \
     asm volatile ("csrrs %0, " #reg ", %1" : "=r"(__tmp) : "rK"(bit)); \
     __tmp; })

#define clear_csr(reg, bit) \
  ({ unsigned long __tmp; \
     asm volatile ("csrrc %0, " #reg ", %1" : "=r"(__tmp) : "rK"(bit)); \
     __tmp; })

#endif /* __GNUC__ */

/****************************************************************************
 * MSTATUS and MIP bit definitions
 *
 * These supplement the CSR macros for interrupt control.
 ****************************************************************************/

#define MSTATUS_MIE     0x00000008
#define MIP_MEIP        0x00000800  /* Machine external interrupt pending */
#define MIP_MTIP        0x00000080  /* Machine timer interrupt pending */
#define MIP_MSIP        0x00000008  /* Machine software interrupt pending */

/****************************************************************************
 * RISC-V Interrupt Cause Codes
 ****************************************************************************/

#define IRQ_M_SOFT      3
#define IRQ_M_TIMER     7
#define IRQ_M_EXT       11

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Function Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

void rv1126b_start(void);
void rv1126b_lowsetup(void);   /* Early UART5 init from rv1126b_lowputc.c */
void rv1126b_clockconfig(void); /* Clock config from rv1126b_clockconfig.c */

#endif /* !__ASSEMBLY__ */

#endif /* __BOARD_CHIP_CHIP_H */

```c
61	backtrace_helper(FAR struct _Unwind_Context *ctx, FAR void *a)
62	{
63	  FAR struct trace_arg *arg = a;
64	
65	  /* We are first called with address in the backtrace function.
66	   * Skip it.
67	   */
68	
69	  if (arg->cnt >= 0)
70	    {
71	      arg->array[arg->cnt] = (FAR void *)_Unwind_GetIP(ctx);
72	      if (arg->cnt > 0)
73	        {
74	          arg->array[arg->cnt]
75	            = unwind_arch_adjustment(arg->array[arg->cnt - 1],
76	                arg->array[arg->cnt]);
77	        }
78	
79	      /* Check whether we make any progress. */
80	
81	      _Unwind_Word cfa = _Unwind_GetCFA(ctx);
82	
83	      if (arg->cnt > 0 &&
84	          arg->array[arg->cnt - 1] == arg->array[arg->cnt] &&
85	          cfa == arg->cfa)
86	        {
87	          return _URC_END_OF_STACK;
88	        }
89	
90	      arg->cfa = cfa;
91	    }
92	
93	  if (++arg->cnt >= arg->size)
94	    {
95	      return _URC_END_OF_STACK;
96	    }
97	
98	  return _URC_NO_REASON;
99	}

116	
117	  if (tid != _SCHED_GETTID())
118	    {
119	      return 0;
120	    }
121	
122	  arg.array = buffer;
123	  arg.cfa = 0;
124	  arg.size = size;
125	  arg.cnt = -skip - 1;
126
```
